# Humans, local LLMs, or both (generated by scripts/run_mixed_panel.py)

DICES-350, expert label as gold. LLM verifiers are local open-weight models scored by log P(Yes) - log P(No) (scripts/label_dices_local.py). AUC against the expert label.

## Single LLM verifiers

| Verifier | AUC all 350 | AUC test half | Accuracy at P = 0.5 (test) |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Meta-Llama-3.1-8B_v1 | 67.8 | 66.6 | 51.1 |
| Meta-Llama-3.1-8B_v4 | 68.2 | 60.7 | 58.5 |
| Qwen3-8B_v1 | 51.2 | 55.4 | 56.8 |
| Qwen3-8B_v4 | 55.2 | 52.1 | 52.8 |
| gemma-3-12b_v1 | 69.8 | 66.2 | 60.2 |
| gemma-3-12b_v4 | 70.0 | 62.0 | 55.1 |

Mean pairwise correlation of scores: LLM verifiers 0.60, human raters 0.24.
